title: A pedigree that shows autosomal recessive inheritance
caption: Two unaffected parents (I-1 and I-2) have an affected child (II-2), which rules out a dominant allele. The affected daughter III-2 has an unaffected father, which rules out X-linked recessive inheritance. That leaves autosomal recessive, and forces II-3 and her parents to be carriers.
alt: A three-generation family tree: unaffected parents I-1 and I-2 have an affected son II-2; unaffected II-3 and II-4 have an affected daughter III-2.
description: Squares are males, circles females, filled symbols affected.
I-1 and I-2 are unaffected but have an affected son, II-2: not dominant.
III-2 is an affected daughter with an unaffected father: not X-linked recessive.
So the pattern is autosomal recessive: I-1, I-2, II-3 and II-4 are all carriers.
